name: WASM Invaders
author: Lorenzo Henrique Zanetti, Matheus Cener
description: A Space Invaders-inspired arcade shooter: defend the galaxy from endless waves of aliens that get faster and more numerous. Left/right to move, X to shoot.

descriptions.en: A Space Invaders-inspired arcade shooter: defend the galaxy from endless waves of aliens that get faster and more numerous. Left/right to move, X to shoot.
descriptions.it: Sparatutto arcade ispirato a Space Invaders: difendi la galassia da ondate infinite di alieni sempre più veloci e numerosi. Sinistra/destra per muoverti, X per sparare.
